title: Black Friday Silver Deals: A Dealer-by-Dealer Guide
summary: What JM Bullion, SD Bullion, Monument Metals, eBay and other sellers have run on Black Friday in past years, when sales start, and how to check a deal.
body_markdown:
Most big bullion dealers run Black Friday sales. The silver deals look alike from year to year: a few generic items sold at spot, often limited to one per household, plus smaller markups on bars bought in quantity, with the sales starting days before Black Friday and running through Cyber Monday. What follows is our own research into what each dealer ran over the past few years, put together to help you plan this year.


None of it is an official list of 2026 deals.


Every dealer sets its own terms. Pure is a marketplace, so it has no store-wide sale; sellers set their own prices. Current silver listings below spot are on the[silver under spot](https://www.collectpure.com/marketplace/featured/silver-under-spot) page.


## What This Guide Can and Can't Tell You


This is a record of past sales. It is not a list of this year's(2026) deals.


Some entries come from the dealers' own Black Friday pages and blog posts. Others come from the yearly roundups at findbullionprices.com, a price-comparison site. Those are marked as reported by them. Of the dealer sites we checked on Nov 16, only Scottsdale Mint had a 2026 page up. Each dealer sets its own prices, limits and dates, so any of them can break the pattern this year.


So treat every line here as a pointer. Check the dealer's own page before you buy anything.


## When Black Friday Bullion Sales Usually Start


Earlier than the name suggests. For 2024, findbullionprices[reported](https://findbullionprices.com/blog/?p=3857) APMEX's pre-Black Friday deals beginning Friday, Nov 22, a full week ahead. Hero Bullion's own 2025 guide put its start at Monday, Nov 24.


Most keep going through the weekend into Cyber Monday. This year Black Friday is Nov 27 and Cyber Monday is Nov 30, so the Monday before Thanksgiving falls on Nov 23.


## What Each Dealer Has Run in Past Years


### JM Bullion


Two Black Friday posts on JM Bullion's own blog cut the markup on popular coins, and neither lists an at-spot price. The November 2020 post priced 1 oz American Silver Eagles at $2.99 over spot. Back in 2014, the Cyber Week post listed a kilo silver bar at 85 cents an ounce over spot.


More recently, findbullionprices[reported](https://findbullionprices.com/blog/cyberweek-2024-top-precious-metals-deals-you-dont-want-to-miss/) a JM Bullion pre-Black Friday sale in 2024, and during Cyber Week that year generic 100 oz silver bars went for 99 cents over melt per ounce.


### SD Bullion


Everything here is as reported by findbullionprices. In its[2023 roundup](https://findbullionprices.com/blog/2023-black-friday-bullion-deals) , SD Bullion's pre-Black Friday sale had silver kilo bars as low as 79 cents over spot per ounce in quantity, plus its 10th Anniversary 1 oz rounds at spot. The[Cyber Week 2025 roundup](https://findbullionprices.com/blog/2025-cyber-week-bullion-deals-gold-silver-at-spot-in-a-real-bull-market/) listed at-spot items including pre-1933 US $20 Saint-Gaudens and Liberty double eagles and a 1 oz Maple Leaf in qualifying quantities. SD Bullion also has a Deals page on its site.


### APMEX


According to findbullionprices, APMEX's 2024 sale started Nov 22, and a 1 oz Silver Eagle offered at spot that year sold out within minutes of going up. Its[2025 roundup](https://findbullionprices.com/blog/black-friday-bullion-deals-2025-the-best-deals-so-far/) says APMEX put a different gold product at spot each day from Nov 24 to Nov 27, in limited quantities, with a free half Arizona Goldback from Black Friday through Cyber Monday.


### Monument Metals


Monument Metals' own 2025 Black Friday post, dated Nov 28, described "weight-focused silver options at spot," reduced premiums on classic US silver coins and spot-priced Krugerrands, with more releases planned for Cyber Monday. The same post said it plainly: "precious metals do not run discounts in a conventional way." Findbullionprices' 2025 roundup also listed a Monument offer of two 1 oz rounds at spot, limited to one order per household.


### Bullion Exchanges


As reported by findbullionprices: Italpreziosi 100 oz bars as low as 70 cents an ounce over spot in 2023, along with discounts on tubes and monster boxes of Silver Eagles. The 2024 sale started early, with markdowns on Krugerrands, Italpreziosi silver bars and IGR gold bars. The 2025 roundup listed tubes of twenty 1 oz rounds at spot, while supplies lasted.


### Hero Bullion


Hero Bullion's 2025 guide, posted Nov 19, said its Black Friday deals would go live Nov 24 on its Deals page and run through Thanksgiving week. The guide said email subscribers would hear first. Findbullionprices reported one of them as 90% silver dimes at $2 per ounce under spot, in select bag sizes.


### Money Metals Exchange


The one record we found is from findbullionprices'[Cyber Week 2024 roundup](https://findbullionprices.com/blog/cyberweek-2024-top-precious-metals-deals-you-dont-want-to-miss/) , which says Money Metals advertised premium cuts on several of its own products that week, including a 41% cut to the premium on 1 gram gold bars. Nothing silver-specific turned up.


### BGASC


BGASC's own blog has an early example of the at-spot doorbuster, from 2017: "U.S. Mint 90% Silver Coins at Spot! November 22-26 Only." A year earlier it ran Black Friday and Cyber Weekend specials "while supplies last" through Nov 28. As of Nov 16, 2026, its site had no Black Friday page up, only its everyday sale section.


### Scottsdale Mint


The one dealer we checked with a 2026 page already live. On Nov 16 its Cyber Monday page read "Coming Soon" over a promise of limited-time pricing on gold and silver bullion, coins, bars and rounds, sold through its website only. Free shipping starts at $499.


### eBay


eBay's big Cyber Week coupon hasn't helped bullion buyers lately. The 2025 code, CYBERWEEK20, took 20% off eligible items up to $500, with two uses per account, from Nov 24 through Dec 1. Its official terms excluded Coins & Paper Money, the eBay category that bullion sits under. A third-party deals blog quoting the 2024 code, SHOPCYBER20, showed the same exclusion. Individual eBay sellers can still discount their own coin listings, but the sitewide codes in 2024 and 2025 didn't apply.


## The Patterns That Repeat Every Year


Three moves keep coming back.


At-spot doorbusters are almost always generic items: rounds, 90% silver coins, a plain bar, or a common gold coin. They headline most sales. Some sold out fast. Some carried a household limit. Findbullionprices' own December 2025[press release](https://stocks.observer-reporter.com/observerreporter/article/abnewswire-2025-12-1-findbullionpricescom-tracks-unprecedented-surge-in-2025-black-friday-gold-and-silver-at-spot-price-deals) said many of that year's offers were "inventory-limited and expected to sell out quickly, some within hours."


The quieter deals are on big bars. Kilo and 100 oz silver bars at under a dollar over spot showed up at three different dealers.


Free-shipping minimums on dealer sites in mid-November 2026, before the sales started:


-


Hero Bullion: free shipping from $149


-


SD Bullion and BGASC: from $199


-


Scottsdale Mint: from $499 on its Cyber Monday page


## How to Check Any Black Friday Deal


Work out the markup per ounce. It takes a minute. Take the sale price, subtract what the metal is worth at today's spot (our[silver chart](https://www.collectpure.com/charts/silver) shows it live), then divide by the ounces. Add shipping and any card surcharge on top. A deal that needs a $199 minimum or charges extra for cards can cost more per ounce than it first looks.


An at-spot item with a one-per-household limit is a low price on one item. It doesn't tell you much about the rest of the store's prices. The[Black Friday gold deals](https://www.collectpure.com/blog/black-friday-gold-deals) post walks through the same math for gold. For when below-spot prices show up at all, see[can you buy silver under spot](https://www.collectpure.com/blog/can-you-buy-silver-under-spot) .


## Where Pure Fits


Pure is a marketplace, so there's no Pure sale to announce. Sellers list at the price they want and buyers bid what they'd pay, and every product page shows the lowest ask and the highest bid. Any price on Pure is its seller's decision, made on whatever day they choose.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### When Do Black Friday Bullion Deals Start?


The Monday before Thanksgiving, give or take. Findbullionprices reported APMEX's 2024 sale starting Friday, Nov 22. This year that Monday is Nov 23.


### Do Black Friday Bullion Deals Have Limits?


In past years the at-spot ones often have. Findbullionprices listed a one-order-per-household limit on a 2025 Monument Metals offer and reported that APMEX's 2024 at-spot Silver Eagle sold out within minutes. Markdowns on bigger bars came with quantity tiers instead.


### Do eBay Black Friday Coupons Work on Coins?


Not eBay's 2025 sitewide code. Its terms excluded Coins & Paper Money, the category bullion sits under, and a third-party write-up of the 2024 terms showed the same exclusion.


### Are Cyber Monday Deals Different From Black Friday?


Mostly a continuation. Monument Metals' 2025 sale ran through the weekend with more releases on Cyber Monday, and findbullionprices noted in 2025 that many retailers extend their promotions into Cyber Week.
